message:
Astra: In the latest draft I can see, what evidence supports your assumption that the assignment creates a name with a leading space?

Would more thinking about the order of your namespace assertions settle whether the added inspection is reachable, or would a small attempt provide better evidence—and what could it establish?

What thinking or doing step do you choose next on this draft, and can you carry it out now without rebuilding the verifier?

What observation would make you change that choice?

In your own concise words, what finding, its source, remaining uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn, distinguishing what source inspection establishes from any execution feedback actually received?
